models.title: Model connections
models.description: Connect your ChatGPT plan or use an API key to generate teaching material.
models.testSuccess: The model responded successfully. You can generate teaching material.
models.subscriptionDescription: Sign in with your ChatGPT account through Codex CLI on the backend. Generation uses your plan allowance; available models and usage depend on your plan.
models.noModels: No available models have been loaded. Refresh the list or sign in again.
models.apiDescription: Enter a Chat Completions endpoint supporting structured output, a model, and your API key. The key field clears after submission.
models.modelPlaceholder: Enter a model name from your provider
models.sessionNote: API keys stay in backend memory and must be entered again after a restart. The ChatGPT sign-in is kept by Codex CLI on the backend and survives restarts; disconnecting signs it out. Testing sends a small model request and counts toward the daily generation limit.
models.loginSuccess: Signed in with ChatGPT. Test the connection or choose a model.
models.codexMissing: Codex CLI is not installed on the backend, so ChatGPT sign-in is unavailable. Use an API key, or start EduForge with the provided Docker images.
models.codeStep1: 1. Open the OpenAI sign-in page and sign in to your ChatGPT account.
models.codeWaiting: Waiting for sign-in… The code expires at {time}. This page updates when you finish.
models.switchAccount: To use another ChatGPT account, disconnect first and sign in again.
models.loginFailed: ChatGPT sign-in was not completed or the code expired. Sign in again.
models.signOutPending: Disconnected, but Codex could not remove its stored sign-in. The connection may return after a backend restart.

errors.invalid_connection: Check the HTTPS endpoint, model, and API key.

errors.plan_permission: Allow ChatGPT plan usage on the consent screen.
errors.connection_limit: The model usage or daily generation limit was reached. Try again later.
errors.connection_failed: The model connection could not be completed. Check settings and network access.
errors.body_too_large: The submitted settings are too long.
